abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide improves blood pressure control compared with Cardivel.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide improves blood pressure control compared with Cardivel.
section:
### Additional comparison

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
